Reason for Mistake: The Planner made an error in performing the final comparison between the directors' birth years. Instead of answering the question correctly (identifying which director was older based solely on their birth years), the Planner mistakenly compared their ages at the respective years when the films were released (1925 vs. 1956). This logic contradicts the question's requirement, as it specifically asked for the comparison based on the directors' chronological ages rather than the ages during the films' release. This flawed reasoning led to the incorrect conclusion that Don McGuire, born in 1919, was older than Nunzio Malasomma, born in 1894, when in fact the latter was older.
